fix(auth): stop a stale session cookie from locking users out of login (#1356)

middleware.ts treated the presence of better-auth.session_token as proof of
a session and redirected /auth, /login, /register and / to /chats. Any
leftover cookie value therefore made login unreachable: /chats has no valid
session, so client-layout.tsx sends the user back to /auth, which the
middleware bounces to /chats again. The browser gives up with
ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS and the login form never renders, so no app code ever
runs to clear the cookie. Incognito worked because it had no cookie.

Sign-out normally clears the cookie, and Better Auth clears it on its own
when it validates a token whose session is gone. Neither can reach a cookie
stored under a different domain or path (left by an AUTH_COOKIE_DOMAIN
change, or the app being served on both an apex and a subdomain), because
the expiry attributes no longer match. HttpOnly cookies cannot be removed
from document.cookie either, so only a server response can clear them.

- middleware: drop the cookie-presence redirect off the login pages. The
  cookie now only gates private routes, which fails safe. Redirecting a
  signed-in user to /chats is already handled in client-layout.tsx against a
  verified session. Read it via getSessionCookie() so the __Secure- prefixed
  name is matched when secure cookies are enabled.
- add POST /api/session-cleanup, which expires every Better Auth cookie
  across host-only and parent domains and across /, /auth, /login and
  /register. Same-origin only, so it cannot be used to force a sign-out.
- logout calls it even when signOut() fails, which previously left the
  cookie behind.
- the login page calls it when the session check comes back empty, which
  recovers browsers that are already stuck.

Reproduced and verified against the live stack (postgres, redis, auth on
:9090, api on :8080, next on :3000): an orphaned cookie ping-ponged
/auth <-> /chats until the browser aborted; after the fix the login page
renders, the orphan is purged, and login succeeds on the same browser.
Production build passes (middleware 35 kB), plus tsc, eslint, prettier, 17
unit tests and all 31 Playwright e2e tests including both logout flows.
